cost_note: MiniMax speech-02-hd via existing paid subscription. ~1MB total for 10 clips. No ElevenLabs needed.
design_rule: Radio justifies the latency. Semi-realtime is fine — the delay is a feature. Short transmissions, callsigns, pauses.

entries.banter: Copy that... full throttle to Sitka. ETA two minutes. Throttle's hot, watch your fuel. Over.
Red copies. Moving to center... in position. Holding. Over.
All units, weapons free! I say again... weapons free. Take that flag! Over.
Banking left... throttling up. You got it. Over.
Easing off... Biorka in sight. Nice and gentle. Copy? Over.
entries.command: Slow down as we approach Biorka Island.

entries.banter: All units halt! Hold what you got... holding. Over.
Blue copies. On the flag... nobody gets past me. Over.
entries.command: Blue, go defend the flag, please.

entries.banter: Pushing her up... full power. We're coming back, hang on. Over.
Holding position. Take your time... we're not going anywhere. Over.
entries.command: Hold position, I need to check something.

entries.banter: Yellow copies. Northbound... contact! Engaging. Cover me! Over.
entries.command: Yellow, move north then engage the enemy.

entries.banter: Red copies. Patrol route alpha... on the move. Sector's quiet. Over.
Blue copies. Patrol route bravo... rolling out. Eyes open. Over.
Yellow copies. Patrol route charlie... holding the line. Nothing moving. Over.
Negative on the halt... we're exposed. Can't stop here. Over.
Didn't catch that... mic keyed with nothing on it. Say again. Over.
Red here... route's cut off. They're dug in. No way through. Over.
Our flag's been stolen! I say again... our flag is gone. All units, eyes up. Over.
Blue is down! I say again... Blue is down. Hold the line. Over.
We got it! Flag captured... I say again, the flag is ours. Bring it home! Over.
Enemy flag's dropped loose... sitting in the open. Grab it. Over.

wiring_note: Games can play the matching banter file on command confirm via new Audio('banter/<file>'). Play AFTER the quilt executes the action — radio readback follows the order, ~1-2s delay is authentic. Out-of-scope commands (e.g. 'do a barrel roll') have no file yet — next batch: refusal banter ('Negative — not in the flight manual. Over.'). New 2026-10-10: patrol acks (per unit), refusals (stop/attack), missed-transmission, and game-event clips (flag stolen/captured/dropped, unit down) wired in index.html.
